baseline_failures.reason: Test expects an Amap constructor option and Amap-first success. Main-pool FixedWeather accepts only Baidu and Moji, so baidu.run throws not_expected. The Baidu/Moji half prints passed before that assertion.
After Baidu HTTP 429 the test expects web-search text matching /成都/. Main pool returns the explicit unverified-weather refusal and does not perform that webpage fallback.

boundaries: Do not replace this main-pool Baidu+Moji path or the explicit unverified-weather refusal with the gray tree Amap-first or webpage-fallback behavior.
Admin preview does not read device location. Bare duplicate names stay ambiguous there. Execution may still narrow through resolveWeatherPlace when a ready province context is supplied.
Archived Rust search-route-preview compilation and this review fixture HTTP/Vue runs are not a formal device voice pass.
The WebKit ambiguous fixture lists two Chaoyang labels. The resolver and HTTP check are authoritative for all three stations.
Logout leaves routing.catalog in memory, but the catalog line renders only while routing.preview is set.

Untracked apps/server/scripts/weather-compiled-http.test.ts appeared during the review, was not created or executed here, and is not part of HEAD. Its own labels say the provider is synthetic and real_device is false.
